articles.title: Nearly half the stocks in the S&P 500 are at cross purposes with the rest of the market
articles.summary: Almost half of the stocks in the S&P 500 have a negative beta, evidence of a chasm between the entire index and its individual components.

Dagli archivi ANSA, la strage di Ustica

articles.title: Aldi boss says some loyalty discounts 'dupe' customers
articles.summary: Aldi is the only major supermarket chain that doesn't operate a loyalty scheme, which are hugely popular and used by millions of shoppers.
